notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Key feature:

 Added Multiplayer:- We added the multiplayer function in the game so the player can play together and enjoy the game.


Changes:-

 improved the storyline:- We improved the storyline in the single-player as well as in multiplayer, so the player can enjoy a good story in the game.
 improved mission system:- We improved the mission system in the game so players can experience a better mission system and enjoy the game 
 fix convert to the object:- we fixed the object convert problem for the player now the player can convert into objects.

 Fix:-

 fixed AI:- we fixed the AI in the game.
 [Fixed Character collision:- We fixed the character Collision in the game.
